flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService.java (createWorkItem* are PLACEHOLDERs for DataHive, not court). ocmsadminui: utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts (Meta without route), pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx, App.tsx. No court work item.
note: 3-point story (status_with_ura is blank/NaN, requirement status not given; traced normally). The story asks OCMS to create a work item for court application interface errors on the OIC dashboard. There is no court interface error detection (OCMS22.23/22.24 do not exist). The general work item mechanism is also not finished: DataHiveUenFinService.createWorkItemForPRSC is a PLACEHOLDER that only logs and returns (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2923), ocmsadminui only has the Meta '/work-item' (WorkItem.ts:1-12) with no route in App.tsx, and Dashboard.tsx has no work item content. Searching work item/OIC dashboard/task list across three layers found no court work item. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The Court Application feature (submission to State Courts) is not in the six repos; only comments, TypeScript types and menu placeholders remain. Ask URA/the team in which repo it was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: OCMS detects court application interface errors from the success/failed report
steps.detail: There is no court interface report or error status (see OCMS22.23 and OCMS22.24), so there is no trigger for a work item.

steps.step: OCMS creates a work item for the error
steps.detail: No work item is created for court application. The general work item mechanism is itself only a PLACEHOLDER: createWorkItemForPRSC only logs and stores nothing (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2923), and it belongs to the DataHive flow, not court.

steps.step: The work item appears on the OIC dashboard so the OIC knows about the error
steps.detail: ocmsadminui only has the Meta '/work-item' (WorkItem.ts:1-12) with no route in App.tsx, and Dashboard.tsx does not show work items. There is no work item list or endpoint for the OIC.
